question: How many users are there in each age category (20s, 30s, 40s, 50s, and others)?
sql:
WITH distinct_users AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_id, birth_date
  FROM mst_users
  WHERE birth_date IS NOT NULL AND birth_date != ''
),
with_age AS (
  SELECT 
    user_id,
    birth_date,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(CAST(birth_date AS DATE)))::INT as age,
    CASE
      WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(CAST(birth_date AS DATE)))::INT BETWEEN 20 AND 29 THEN '20s'
      WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(CAST(birth_date AS DATE)))::INT BETWEEN 30 AND 39 THEN '30s'
      WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(CAST(birth_date AS DATE)))::INT BETWEEN 40 AND 49 THEN '40s'
      WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(CAST(birth_date AS DATE)))::INT BETWEEN 50 AND 59 THEN '50s'
      ELSE 'others'
    END as age_category
  FROM distinct_users
)
SELECT 
  age_category,
  COUNT(*) as user_count
FROM with_age
GROUP BY age_category
ORDER BY 
  CASE age_category
    WHEN '20s' THEN 1
    WHEN '30s' THEN 2
    WHEN '40s' THEN 3
    WHEN '50s' THEN 4
    WHEN 'others' THEN 5
  END
